mapper.sql: branche_types.id AS id, branche_types.name AS name, branche_types.created AS created, branche_types.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy
FROM branche_types LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = branche_types.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = branche_types.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM branche_types WHERE is_active = 1 AND (name = #{name}) AND id != #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branche_types ( name, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{branchType.name}, NOW(), #{branchType.createdBy}, 1 )
